content_sections.heading: RCB Junior Research Fellow Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the RCB Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow: M.Sc. degree in Life Sciences/Biotechnology with minimum 60% marks and NET or any National-Level JRF eligibility test qualification. Practical knowledge of basic molecular biology techniques including nucleic acid extraction and gene expression analysis.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: All Posts: Maximum age limit is 30 years. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow: Rs. 37,000 + 27% HRA per month

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for RCB Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the Regional Centre for Biotechnology (RCB), a government organization located in Faridabad, Haryana.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive is Junior Research Fellow, which is a Junior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Project-JRF post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Project-JRF post in the Regional Centre for Biotechnology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for RCB Project-JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the RCB Project-JRF recruitment is a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend in person.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date for Project-JRF?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project-JRF position at RCB is scheduled for 19 August 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications for Project-JRF?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.Sc. degree in Life Sciences/Biotechnology with at least 60% marks and NET or a National-Level JRF eligibility test qualification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for the Project-JRF post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project-JRF post is 30 years as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Project-JRF position?
faq.answer: The Project-JRF position offers a salary of Rs. 37,000 plus 27% HRA per month, totaling approximately Rs. 37000 per month.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for the RCB Project-JRF walk-in interview?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the RCB Project-JRF walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for Project-JRF at RCB?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project-JRF position at Regional Centre for Biotechnology will be based entirely on a Walk-in Interview.
